entities.summary: "El Perdón" is a song by American singer Nicky Jam and Spanish singer Enrique Iglesias released as the first single to Nicky Jam's third studio album Fénix (2017). An English-language version of the song, titled "Forgiveness", was released on July 10, 2015. The single was later included on Enrique Iglesias' eleventh studio album Final (2021).
